question: How does contemplation of Shiva affect the mind bound in transmigration?
premises: The mind can be bound in transmigration
Contemplation of Shiva functions as medicine
This medicine acts upon the bound mind
inference: When the mind bound in transmigration is held by the medicine of Shiva-contemplation, its bondage is addressed.
uncertainties: The resulting liberation is implied but not explicitly stated in this verse
plain_english: When the mind is bound in transmigration, it is held by the medicine of contemplation on Shiva.
